envelope.description: Compute vibeOutcome from export.json on exit and clean up the export directory

body.title: Compute vibeOutcome from export.json on exit and clean up the export directory
body.summary: On process exit, read export.json via the now-exported readExitEvidence and classify vibeOutcome ('ok' | 'no-evidence' | 'replay-unsafe') from Vibe's real reported stopReason/outcome; remove the per-turn export directory (from t4) in a finally block on every exit path (clean exit, error, cancellation).
acceptanceChecks: vibeOutcome is computed from export.json's real stopReason/outcome fields, never inferred from merely having decoded a row
the export directory is removed on every exit path, including an error or cancelled turn

tests.name: readExitEvidence-driven outcome classification: stopReason undefined -> 'ok'; stopReason present -> 'replay-unsafe'; export.json missing/malformed -> 'no-evidence'
a fixture binary exiting cleanly with no stopReason yields vibeOutcome 'ok', read identically live and on reattach
a fixture binary exiting cleanly with a stopReason yields vibeOutcome 'replay-unsafe' despite exit code 0
